detail.stateMachine:
MEDIA ASSET review_status — runtime values (production/lib/media.mjs, media-uploads.mjs, media-reviews.mjs):
  needs_media_review | approved_imported_photo | reviewed_private | approved_by_human | replaced_by_human
DECLARED enum in production/data/cms-collections.json media_assets.review_status is only [approved_imported_photo, reviewed_private, review_required] — needs_media_review, approved_by_human and replaced_by_human are written at runtime but are NOT in the declared collection enum, and review_required is declared but never written by media.mjs. That is real drift, not a reading error.

Legal transitions:
 T1 (seed classify) — media.mjs:normalizeMediaAsset. nothing -> approved_imported_photo when kind=photo AND an imported WP original resolves; -> reviewed_private when kind=site_chrome; -> needs_media_review otherwise.
 T2 (upload) — media-uploads.mjs:createMediaUploadRecord. nothing -> needs_media_review with is_public forced false. media-uploads.mjs:assertMediaUploads throws if a row arrives any other way.
 T3 (review, publish) — media-reviews.mjs:createMediaReview, decision="publish". any -> approved_by_human, is_public=true. Requires: known listingId, known assetId, non-empty reviewer, reviewConfirmed truthy, non-empty alt (<=500 chars), HTTPS asset URL that is image-typed AND on the owned host (/media/ or /wp-content/uploads/); a site_chrome item additionally requires replacementUrl; a video requires a video-typed URL.
 T4 (review, keep private) — decision="keep_private". any -> reviewed_private, is_public=false. This is the only unpublish path.
 T5 (replacement approved) — media-reviews.mjs:applyMediaReviews. The superseded asset -> replaced_by_human, is_public=false, gains replacement_asset_id + media_reviewer + media_reviewed_at. Triggered when a row carrying replaces_asset_id gets its own publish review.
 T6 (listing publication, bulk side effect) — listing-publication-sql.mjs. Every attached row with kind='photo' AND review_status='review_required' -> is_public=true, review_status='approved_imported_photo', _status='published', plus the same flip on _media_assets_v. Publishing a listing publishes its photos.
 T7 (blanket per-listing sign-off) — listing-edits.mjs:applyListingEdits via an edit carrying media_reviewer. Every non-public asset on that listing -> reviewed_private + media_reviewer, and media_workflow.review_gated_assets is forced to 0. Reachable through POST /api/admin/listing-quality/import (a media_reviewer CSV column).
 No transition deletes an asset. No transition restores one. There is no draft/pending intermediate: a review is a single atomic decision.

is_public is derived, never settable: media-uploads.mjs:assertMediaUploads refuses is_public!==false on an upload row, and media-reviews.mjs:assertMediaReviews refuses is_public without review_status="approved_by_human".

PUBLICATION GATE — listing-facts.mjs:publicationReadinessFor adds check "media_review": ready only when media_workflow.review_gated_assets === 0 (an asset counts as gated when !is_public && review_status !== "reviewed_private"). media-uploads.mjs deliberately carries the pre-upload gate count forward and reports new uploads as pending_upload_reviews so an upload cannot take a live listing off the site.

TOUR review_status — tours.mjs:TOUR_REVIEW_STATUSES = [needs_panorama_upload, needs_viewer_upload, review_required, approved, published].
 TT1 (seed) — cms-seed.mjs calls createTourField with isPublic=false: -> needs_panorama_upload for photo-sphere-viewer, needs_viewer_upload for supersplat-viewer.
 TT2 (approve+publish) — POST /api/admin/tours/approve -> tours.mjs:createTourApproval -> createTourField({isPublic:true}) -> "approved", is_public=true. Requires reviewer, reviewConfirmed, the provider's source URL on an approved MS Realty HTTPS origin (ms-realty.ms-realty-bg.workers.dev or a subdomain), a non-empty accessibility_caption, and a non-empty derived fallback_gallery.
 review_required is in the enum and is the react-admin-site.mjs default display value, but NO code path writes it. "published" is in the enum and in the collection workflow list and is written by NOTHING — it is unreachable.
 There is no revoke, unapprove, expire or delete transition for a tour. Un-publishing one requires editing the ledger file by hand.
 Provider is exclusive: photo-sphere-viewer accepts only panorama_url, supersplat-viewer only viewer_url; supplying the wrong one throws.

FIELD EDITABILITY (media asset): url immutable+unique (from crawl page or content hash); asset_id immutable (media-<sha256(source_url)[:20]>, or for an upload media-<sha256(contentHash[:replacesAssetId])[:20]>); source_url/asset_url/fallback_asset_url/thumbnail_url derived; alt editable ONLY through a review (<=500 chars, required to publish, declared localized:true in the collection but only one string is ever stored); kind editable at review among photo|floor_plan|video (upload restricted to photo|floor_plan by MEDIA_UPLOAD_KINDS); width/height derived from the decode and nulled when a WordPress original was recovered; is_public/review_status derived from the decision; media_reviewer/media_reviewed_at/uploaded_by/uploaded_at/source immutable attribution; content_hash/storage_key/storage_driver/format/content_type/bytes/bytes_before/bytes_after immutable and derived; metadata_stripped/metadata_removed_bytes/optimized/orientation_applied/resized derived evidence; replaces_asset_id/replacement_asset_id write-once.

FIELD EDITABILITY (tour): provider, panorama_url, viewer_url, thumbnail_url, accessibility_caption editable at approval (all HTTPS-validated); listing_id immutable; hotspots is a required array that createTourField always sets to [] and no code path ever writes; fallback_gallery derived (tours.mjs:galleryFallback, first 6 unique imported photos, alt defaulted to "Property photo") and marked readOnly in the collection; is_public/review_status/reviewer/approved_at derived from the approval.

detail.stateMachine:
Nine interacting state machines touch a Listing.

(1) facts.listing_status — states: available (default), reserved, sold, rented, archived (production/lib/listing-edits.mjs:LISTING_STATUSES). Every transition is legal in both directions; the only validation is enum membership (normalizePatchValue). Written by POST /api/admin/listings/edit (single) and POST /api/admin/listings/status (bulk, max 100 ids, MAX_BULK_LISTING_EDITS). A schedule execution constrains the target: action=publish -> available|reserved (PUBLISH_STATUSES), action=unpublish -> archived (forced).

(2) cms_status — states: source_imported_review_required -> draft -> review -> published -> archived (production/data/cms-collections.json listings.workflow). NO admin HTTP route writes it. Writers: listing-publication-projection.mjs (-> published on apply; -> source_imported_review_required on revert), listing-publication-sql.mjs:freezeActivePublicationSql (-> published), payload-cms-import.mjs (-> source_imported_review_required on import), and the Payload native admin at /payload-admin.

(3) Publication schedule — event log with states scheduled -> cancelled | executed (listing-publication-schedules.mjs:deriveListingPublicationScheduleStates). Event types: scheduled, cancelled, executed. Guards: at most one open schedule per listing; scheduled_at must be strictly after created_at; cancel only from scheduled and requires a reason (<=500 chars); execute only when scheduled_at <= now; a publish schedule calls assertPublicationReady({requirePublishApproval:true}) at BOTH create and execute time; actor may never match /hermes/i (assertNonHermesActor); execution with previous_status === target_status records a noop event with no listing edit.

(4) Per-property-field fact verification — unknown -> entered_pending_review -> broker_verified, plus not_applicable as a family-determined terminal state (listing-facts.mjs:FACT_VERIFICATION_STATES). Confirming a source-stated figure promotes entered_pending_review -> broker_verified (listing-fact-review.mjs:factPromotionsFor). A numeric 0 that is not broker_verified is coerced to null and flagged in zero_value_audit.

(5) Publication readiness gate (listing-facts.mjs:publicationReadinessFor) — checks property_family(mapped), location_id(+location_verified_at), primary area field(broker_verified & >0), bedrooms_count(if applicable), price_amount(>0 + price_verified_at) or price_on_request(+price_on_request_verified_at), availability_verified_at, seo.human_approved, media_review(review_gated_assets===0), and publish_approved when requirePublishApproval. Any unready applicable check becomes a blocking_field and assertPublicationReady throws.

(6) Publication sync entry actions (listing-publication-projection.mjs:buildListingPublicationSyncPlan) — apply | revert | unchanged | refuse | skip, with named refusal reasons: seed_record_is_not_marked_published, seed_record_carries_no_publish_approval, seed_publish_approval_is_missing_approver_or_timestamp, listing_is_not_named_by_the_owner_publication_approval, listing_has_no_row_in_the_payload_database, database_listing_status_is_not_publicly_listable; and skip reason database_listing_is_absent_from_the_committed_seed. Revert fires only when the approval explicitly excludes the listing AND workflow.publish_approved_by matches the approval's approved_by.

(7) Translation state per locale, driven by listing edits — published/approved -> stale (status=draft, translation_state=stale, public_indexable=false) whenever the listing source hash changes (listing-draft-service.mjs:markListingTranslationsStale). The source locale is never staled.

(8) listing_tours.review_status — needs_panorama_upload | needs_viewer_upload | review_required -> approved -> published (cms-collections.json listing_tours.workflow).

(9) media_assets review_status — review_required -> reviewed_private | approved_by_human (is_public=true) (media-reviews.mjs:createMediaReview).

Field mutability. Immutable: id, source_url, source_domain, source_locale, property (relationship), created/imported provenance. Editable via POST /api/admin/listings/edit (DURABLE_LISTING_EDIT_FIELDS): title, h1, description, location, property_type, offer_type, listing_status, bedrooms, bedrooms_not_applicable, area_sqm, price_eur, price_on_request, floor, total_floors, land_area_sqm, condition, location_precision, availability_verified_at, location_verified_at, price_verified_at, price_on_request_verified_at, seo_title, seo_description, seo_canonical, seo_og_title, seo_og_description, seo_robots. Explicitly PROHIBITED on that route: publish_approved and seo_review_confirmed (listing-draft-service.mjs:PROHIBITED_FIELDS). Derived: facts.primary_area_sqm (derivePrimaryAreaSqm), seo.human_approved/reviewer/reviewed_at/review_status (from seo_review_confirmed), workflow.*_verified_by (from the matching *_verified_at plus the actor), workflow.publish_approved_by/at, workflow.last_editor/last_edited_at/last_edit_event, source_hash_before/after, stale_locales, media_workflow.review_gated_assets, property.fact_verification, property.zero_value_audit.

Validators (listing-edits.mjs:normalizePatchValue): text max 240 (description 20000, *description 320); price_eur > 0; area_sqm > 0; land_area_sqm > 0; bedrooms/floor/total_floors non-negative integers; listing_status in the 5-value enum; location_precision in area_only|approximate|exact; seo_robots in "index,follow"|"noindex,follow"; seo_canonical must be root-relative with no query or fragment and not start with "//"; verification timestamps must parse and may not be later than editedAt (assertWorkflowTimestampsAtOrBefore); price_on_request=true forces price_eur=null; edits may not contain contact/email/phone/message keys (assertListingEdits).

detail.stateMachine:
FOUR interlocking machines govern whether a page or block is public. None is exposed as a control anywhere in the code.

(A) APPROVED-RECORD LIFECYCLE — production/lib/approved-records.mjs#normalizeApproval + #approvalState. Governs area guides, guide translations, team profiles, financing partners, purchase-fee lines.
STORED STATES: `draft` | `approved` | `withdrawn` (any other value throws).
DERIVED PUBLICATION VERDICT: publishable=true, or publishable=false with one of six named reasons (APPROVAL_REASONS): `example_record`, `not_approved`, `no_named_reviewer`, `changed_since_approval`, `approval_expired`, `translation_not_approved`.
LEGAL TRANSITIONS, all by hand-editing JSON in production/data/ then re-running a build script — there is no route and no button:
  draft -> approved: requires human_approved===true AND reviewer matching /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{1,63}$/i AND approved_at parseable. normalizeApproval THROWS on status "approved" without human_approved, so the transition cannot be faked.
  approved -> draft, approved -> withdrawn, withdrawn -> approved: file edit only. `withdrawn` is accepted by the validator and used by nothing — no unpublish path reaches it.
  approved -> BLOCKED(changed_since_approval): AUTOMATIC AND SILENT. Any edit to a field inside the type's hashPayload makes source_hash !== stableHash(hashPayload(record)) and the page section stops publishing on the next build. This is the single most important transition in the object and the design surfaces it nowhere: an editor who fixes a typo unpublishes the block.
  approved -> BLOCKED(approval_expired): AUTOMATIC, TIME-DRIVEN. Fires when review_due_at <= now. No record currently sets review_due_at, so nothing expires today.
  approved -> BLOCKED(translation_not_approved): automatic for any record whose locale !== source_locale unless BOTH source_document_id is set AND human_translation_approved===true.
  example_record:true -> permanently BLOCKED(example_record), whatever the status says. Seed rows fail closed.
(B) DRAFT-TRANSLATION LANE — production/lib/guide-translations.mjs. A one-way holding pen: normalizeGuideTranslation THROWS if human_translation_approved===true, and assertDraftGuideTranslations THROWS if any row reports itself publishable. The only exit is a human physically moving the record into approved-cms-content.json and supplying reviewer + approved_at + human_approved + human_translation_approved. cmsDocumentFromDraft() deliberately emits status:"draft" with an empty approval envelope so no script can promote a row. 15 rows sit here.
(C) CMS GUIDE PUBLICATION GATE — production/lib/approved-content.mjs#isPublishableGuide. Nine conjunctive conditions: type==="guide", status==="approved", guide_key, locale, source_locale, human_approved===true, approved_at parses, source_hash===guideSourceHash(doc), and (locale===source_locale OR (source_document_id AND human_translation_approved)); finally legacy_migration===true OR hasCurrentSourceEvidence() — every source must carry id + publisher + checked_at + a claim_ids array + an https: URL.
(D) LOCALE PUBLICATION GATE — production/lib/locales.mjs. Per locale: public_enabled (bool) and indexable (bool, force-ANDed to public_enabled at addLocaleToRegistry). resolvePublicLocale falls back to fallback_locale then source_locale. Consequences differ by page type: renderHomePage stays 200 with robots "noindex,follow"; renderGuidePage returns status 404 when not indexable; renderLocationPage returns 404 when there is no matching inventory. Both flags are settable ONLY at locale creation (POST /api/admin/locales) — there is no update route, so a language cannot be turned off once on.
ADJACENT — LEGACY ROUTE DECISION (production/lib/redirect-approvals.mjs): `redirect_301` | `retain_200` | `approved_410`, terminal, each requiring a named reviewer; redirect_301 additionally requires an explicit internal targetPath that resolves to published, non-home public content.
RENDER-TIME STATUS (derived, not stored): 200 | 404 per render* function.
NOTE ON AUDIT: production/lib/audit-log.mjs registers locale_created, translation_drafted/approved/published, redirect_approval_created, seo_evidence_imported and ~30 others — but NO page_created, page_edited, page_published or block_* action. Any page write the design implies would need a new whitelisted action or the deploy fails after a green unit test.

detail.stateMachine:
THREE separate machines, plus a fourth (checklist item) that is not modelled as one.

=== 1. CASE STATUS (realty-cases.mjs:deriveRealtyCases, guards in planRealtyCaseAction) ===
States: active (implicit on case_opened) · frozen · closed · cancelled.
Transitions:
- (none) --case_opened--> active. Requires jurisdiction BG|GR, known case_type, asset_kind in {residential, commercial, land, new_build, mixed_use}, execution_mode manual|autonomous, a non-expired mandate whose capabilities allow "open", and for autonomous an assurance_ref. Manual + assuranceRef is rejected.
- active --case_frozen(authorityRef, reasonCode)--> frozen. Guard: "Only an active case can be frozen".
- frozen --case_resumed(authorityRef)--> active. Guard: "Only a frozen case can be resumed".
- active --case_closed--> closed. Guard: "Only an active case can close" AND every step must be in {completed, not_applicable}. No authority or reason required.
- active|frozen --case_cancelled(authorityRef, reasonCode)--> cancelled. No status guard beyond the immutability rule, so a frozen case can be cancelled directly.
- closed, cancelled: terminal. "Closed or cancelled cases are immutable" rejects every further action.
- While frozen, all step_* actions are refused ("A frozen case must be resumed before steps can change"); mode_changed, case_resumed and case_cancelled still pass.
Orthogonal: execution_mode manual <--mode_changed(authorityRef, new mandate, assuranceRef if autonomous)--> autonomous. Rejected if the target equals the current mode. mode_changed replaces mandate and assurance_ref wholesale.

=== 2. CASE STEP STATUS (per step key; deriveRealtyCases + planRealtyCaseAction) ===
States: pending (initial for every generated step) · completed · not_applicable · blocked. RESOLVED = {completed, not_applicable}.
Transitions:
- pending|blocked --step_completed(evidenceRefs[1..20])--> completed. Guards: earlier phases all resolved (assertEarlierPhasesResolved); current status not already resolved ("Resolved case steps are immutable"); at least one evidence ref whose producer_kind is in that step's evidence_producers; each ref is {ref, type, producer_kind, issued_at?, digest?} and must contain no private keys.
- pending|blocked --step_not_applicable(authorityRef, reasonCode)--> not_applicable. Guards: step.optional must be true ("Required case steps cannot be marked not applicable"); earlier phases resolved; not already resolved.
- pending --step_blocked(reasonCode)--> blocked. Guards: earlier phases resolved; not already resolved. (blocked --step_blocked--> blocked is also legal; the guard only excludes resolved states.)
- completed|not_applicable|blocked --step_reopened(authorityRef, reasonCode)--> pending (clears evidence_refs). Guards: status must not already be pending ("Pending case step does not need reopening"); NO step in a later phase may be resolved ("Case step cannot reopen after a later phase has advanced"). The phase gate is deliberately skipped for reopen.
Phases, in order and fixed: intake, onboarding, evidence, commercial, market, agreement, completion, aftercare. current_phase = lowest-ranked phase holding an unresolved step, or "complete".

=== 3. CONDITION STATUS (realty-case-conditions.mjs:applyConditionEvent) ===
States: open (initial on condition_opened) · satisfied · blocked · expired · waived. ACTIVE (returned by the queue) = {open, blocked, expired}.
Transitions:
- (none) --condition_opened(conditionType, dueAt > recordedAt, requiredEvidenceProducerRefs[1..20])--> open. Owning case must be status=active.
- open|blocked --condition_satisfied(evidenceRefs[{ref, producer_ref}])--> satisfied. Guard: the set of producer_refs must cover EVERY required_evidence_producer_ref.
- open --condition_blocked(reasonCode)--> blocked. Guard: "Only an open condition can be blocked".
- open|blocked --condition_expired--> expired. Guard: recorded_at >= due_at ("Condition cannot expire before its dueAt"). Manual event; nothing expires a condition automatically.
- open|blocked|expired --condition_waived(authorityRef, reasonCode)--> waived. Guards: current status not in {satisfied, waived}; human executor only.
- satisfied|blocked|expired|waived --condition_reopened(authorityRef, reasonCode, new dueAt > recordedAt)--> open (clears evidence_refs). Guards: status must not be open; human executor only.
- There is NO transition that changes due_at on an open condition. "Extend a deadline" does not exist as an operation.
Derived only: due_state = overdue when status=expired or due_at < generated_at, else due.

=== 4. CHECKLIST ITEM STATUS (document-checklists.mjs — derived from the latest ledger row, not an explicit machine) ===
States: pending (no outcome row) · complete · blocked · not_applicable.
Transitions:
- pending --outcome(status=complete, actor, humanConfirmed, note OR reference)--> complete.
- pending --outcome(status=blocked, actor, humanConfirmed, note REQUIRED)--> blocked.
- pending --outcome(status=not_applicable, actor, humanConfirmed, note REQUIRED)--> not_applicable.
- blocked --outcome(any of the three)--> that status. Blocked is re-recordable; only complete and not_applicable are guarded ("Completed document checklist items are immutable").
- complete, not_applicable: terminal. There is no reopen, no un-tick, and status="pending" is explicitly rejected as an input.
Every write is append-only; the derived status is the last row for (lead_id, item_key). Idempotency is by row id or by an identical (lead_id, item_key, status, actor, note, reference) tuple.

detail.stateMachine:
FOUR state machines govern this object.

(1) OPERATOR SECOND FACTOR — production/lib/operator-two-factor.mjs:operatorTwoFactorStates. States: not_enrolled (implicit, no rows) | pending | active | disabled. Legal transitions, each an append-only ledger event: not_enrolled --enrolment_started--> pending; pending --activated (requires a TOTP code that verifies against the enrolment envelope)--> active; active --verified (in-state, advances last_counter; replay-guarded via afterCounter)--> active; active --recovery_code_used (in-state, burns one code index; only tried when the input is NOT TOTP-shaped, so a mistyped digit never burns a code)--> active; active --disabled (own: requires a currently valid code; other operator: requires team:manage AND the manager's own step-up when the manager has an active factor)--> disabled; pending --disabled--> disabled; disabled --enrolment_started--> pending (re-enrol is the only way back). Events for an enrolment_id other than the operator's current one are ignored. Re-enrolling while pending or active is refused with 409 two_factor_already_enrolled. If MS_REALTY_OPERATOR_2FA_KEY is missing or rotated, openEnrolment returns null and verification fails closed (never downgrades to "no second factor").

(2) ADMIN SESSION — production/lib/admin-sessions.mjs:adminSessionStates. States: active | revoked | expired. Transitions: (none) --session_opened--> active; active --session_seen (in-state, advances last_seen_at; only written when adminSessionSeenDue, i.e. >=300s since last touch)--> active; active --session_revoked--> revoked; active --(expires_at <= now, computed on read)--> expired. Revoked and expired are terminal. Revocation reasons are a closed set: operator_request | revoke_others | team_manage | sign_out | security_response. isAdminSessionRevoked refuses on the revocation row alone, before the token reaches Payload, so revocation is server-side and not merely cookie clearing. Only the fingerprint (SHA-256 of the token) is stored; the public session_id is what the UI passes back.

(3) WORKSPACE EXPORT JOB — production/lib/workspace-export.mjs:workspaceExportJobs. States: queued | ready | downloaded | expired | failed. Transitions: (none) --export_requested--> queued; queued --export_completed--> ready; ready --export_downloaded--> downloaded (terminal, single use: a second fetch is 410 export_already_downloaded); ready --(download_expires_at <= now)--> expired (terminal, 410 export_link_expired); queued|ready --export_failed--> failed. claimWorkspaceExportDownload checks the token before ownership so a wrong token and a wrong owner are indistinguishable.

(4) PROVIDER CONNECTION — two overlapping vocabularies. Stored row status (production/lib/provider-connections.mjs:saveProviderConnection accepts only "connecting" | "connected"); WhatsApp and Viber are saved twice: once as connecting after account readback, again as connected once the webhook subscription is confirmed. Card status (production/lib/operator-provider-catalog.mjs:operatorProviderCards) derives: connecting | unavailable (pass-through from the row) | disabled (definition.supported === false) | connected | inactive (AI connected but a self-hosted Hermes runtime outranks it) | not_connected (availability ready, no row) | needs_setup (availability not ready). Declared owner lifecycle (OWNER_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE, enabled providers only): authorizing -> connected -> reauthorize -> error -> disconnected. Disconnect is a row DELETE, not a status flip, so the encrypted credential envelope stops existing at the moment the operator says stop.

WORKSPACE SETTINGS is not a state machine but a monotonic revision counter: every non-idempotent save bumps revision by 1, stamps updated_at/updated_by, writes a per-section section_updates entry, and appends a bounded revision row (MAX_WORKSPACE_SETTINGS_REVISIONS = 200, oldest dropped). A save whose changed_fields is empty AND whose section already has a section_updates entry returns idempotent:true and does not bump the revision or write an audit row. There is no transition backwards: no revert-to-revision exists anywhere in the code.
